Plants subterranean, mycoheterotrophic, lacking chlorophyll, with a fleshy horizontal rhizome; pseudobulbs absent and true leaves absent. Inflorescence a subterranean capitulum of numerous small flowers enclosed by large overlapping bracts. Flowers small, not resupinate, cleistogamous. Sepals and petals reduced, forming a short hood over the column. Labellum reduced, narrow, obscurely lobed, much smaller than the other perianth segments. Floral spur absent. Pollinia 4, in two pairs, without a distinct caudicle. Flowering May to June.
